prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1298; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the details of what happened, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. We'll get to the details. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle you were operating at the time?

A: Yes, I was driving my own car. I had just pulled into a space near the store entrance.

Q: Where were you headed when the collision occurred?

A: I was looking for an open spot. There were a lot of cars backing out, so I was going slow, maybe five or ten miles an hour.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I heard a horn and then felt the hit on the driver's side rear of my car. It came from my right as I was turning.

Q: Did you notice any injuries immediately after the collision?

A: My neck felt fine at first, but within an hour it got stiff. By that evening I had a headache and sharp pain when I turned my head.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They diagnosed me with whiplash and told me to wear a soft collar and follow up with my doctor.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?

A: Yes, the stiffness and headaches are still there. Some days are worse than others, and I've had trouble sleeping.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want my vehicle repaired as soon as possible, since I need it for work.

Q: Understood. This concludes our recorded statement. Thank you.
